The DBU MBA develops more than just careers. They are committed to excellence in academics and investing in students' personal development. DBU is a teaching institution by design, meaning their professors' top priority is to equip students to succeed.

The MBA at Dallas Baptist University empowers graduates to lead organizations and influence communities. A non-thesis master’s degree, the DBU MBA can be completed in as few as 18 months. Flexible classes, including in-class and online sessions, are built for the working professional.
